data.name: Durriyyah
data.gender_notes: Durriyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Durriyyah means 'gem', 'precious stone'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'darr' which means 'to be hard or firm'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes the inner beauty and strength of a woman, just like a precious gem. The name Durriyyah carries the meaning “Gem, Precious Stone” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Durriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gem, precious stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durriyyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
